title: Grateful Dead Live at Campus Stadium - University Of California on 1973-05-20
lineage: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v9.11 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a sunny 1973 UCSB show, highlighted by a soaring third set with a monster 19‑minute “Playing In The Band”, “Other One” and “Eyes of the World”.
ai_review.review: The Charlie Miller transfer delivers crystal‑clear, super‑73 soundboard quality that lets every instrument shine, despite occasional minor glitches. Musically the concert is a classic California summer performance – solid throughout with an especially electrifying third set that many fans cite as the show’s high point.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 4‑5 stars) and strong praise for both performance and sound quality; weighted average of show (≈4.0) and recording (≈4.8) yields ~4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Super‑73 soundboard transfer by Charlie Miller; described as pristine, crystal‑clear and top‑shelf with only occasional minor drop‑outs or wind noise.

standout_songs: Playing In The Band (19 min jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong overall flow with a slightly shaky first set that gives way to an outstanding third set; the concert builds nicely and maintains high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Raspy, teenage‑year vocal tone noted; sings passionately despite a cold, delivering emotive performances.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass described as fired‑up and “bombing” in the third set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work praised along with Donna’s angelic harmonies; keyboards are prominent and well‑balanced.
